title: SoTa: Soft Tactile Skins for Dexterous Manipulation
description:
arXiv:2610.02338v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: A growing body of work suggests that tactile sensing gives robot policies contact information that complements vision in dexterous manipulation. However, visuo-tactile robot data remains scarce: dexterous demonstrations require teleoperating robots, which limits dataset scale.
